dev.role: development only: already used in S4; reported as exploratory, never part of the decision

heldout.role: decision set: gold drafted by script from the PDF page text, every question checked by a person against the printed page, frozen before any retrieval or model call on it; run once

refused.qwen3:8b: loads with a 4096-token context and silently truncates longer prompts

covers: prompt and schema of every role
check list shared by self_check and verifier
pins.may_change: on the development set only, each change committed; the last commit before the held-out run counts

arms.label: 单 Agent 自检
arms.note: same role, same system prompt, sees all hits again plus its own answer; may keep, revise or withdraw

arms.label: A：执行者 + 核对者
arms.note: verifier sees the question, the answer and the cited passages only; veto only; pass stops; one retry; second veto is NEEDS_REVIEW

arms.label: B：规划者 + A
arms.note: planner sees the question and the report list only; retrieval is narrowed to the planned report and uses the rewritten query; an invalid plan or a planned retrieval without hits falls back to the original retrieval

verifier_pass_requires: quote of at least 6 characters found verbatim in a cited passage

statuses.NEEDS_REVIEW: vetoed twice: no answer shown; answerable = not correct and not wrong-but-confident; absent = correct; counted separately per kind

sharing.retrieval: once per question for single, self_check and verify; plan_verify adds its planned retrieval
sharing.model_calls: a call with identical messages and schema is sent to the model once per run and its output is shared across arms; calls and time are counted per arm as if it ran alone
sharing.resume: an interrupted run continues from the call records on disk

reported: model calls per question and per step
plan statuses and page recall after planned retrieval

decision_rule.both_pass: adopt the arm with more answerable questions correct; on a tie adopt verify (fewer calls)
decision_rule.otherwise: not adopted: single answer stays the default, orchestration stays opt-in; reported as measured

out_of_scope: orchestrated answers do not enter the research approval flow
plan_verify is not wired into the desk-service worker in this round
